title: 1. Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Coding problems structured by pattern — the same patterns Turing OA (2-4 problems, 90-120 min) and Andela HR (2-4 problems, 60-90 min) draw from. Per-problem time budget matches real tests (10 min easy / 20 min medium / 30 min hard).

questions.prompt: Two Sum: given nums[] and target, return indices of two numbers adding to target. Exactly one solution exists.
Contains Duplicate: return true if any value appears at least twice.
questions.explanation:
```js
const hasDup = nums => new Set(nums).size !== nums.length;
```
O(n) / O(n).

questions.prompt: Move Zeroes: move all 0s to end, in-place, preserve relative order.
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock (single txn): given prices[], max profit.
Product of Array Except Self (no division, O(n)).
Maximum Subarray (Kadane): find contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
Missing Number (Codility PermMissingElem): array contains 1..N+1 with one missing; find it.
questions.explanation:
```js
const missing = A => (A.length + 1) * (A.length + 2) / 2 - A.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0);
```
Expected sum - actual sum. O(n) / O(1).

Intersection of Two Arrays (unique elements).
questions.explanation:
```js
const intersection = (a, b) => [...new Set(a)].filter(x => new Set(b).has(x));
```
Better (O(n+m)):
```js
function intersection(a, b) { const sa = new Set(a); return [...new Set(b)].filter(x => sa.has(x)); }
```

questions.prompt: Which is TRUE about a hash-map's average vs worst-case complexity?

options.text: O(1) average, O(n) worst (bucket collisions or resize)

questions.explanation: Good hash + low load factor = O(1). Adversarial keys or all-same-bucket = O(n). Java 8+ uses red-black trees for long buckets → O(log n) worst.

questions.prompt: In Python, why can't a list be a dict key but a tuple can?

options.text: Dict keys must be hashable (immutable). Lists are mutable — their hash could change and corrupt the map.

questions.explanation: Hash of a key MUST be stable for the entry's lifetime. Frozenset works too. Custom classes need __hash__ + __eq__.

questions.explanation:
Trick: `(s + s).slice(1, -1).includes(s)`.
```js
const repeatedSubstringPattern = s => (s + s).slice(1, -1).includes(s);
```
